title: cereus nyctago
intro: Cereus nyctago, commonly known as Queen of the Night or Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. It is prized for its stunning white flowers that bloom at night and wilt before dawn. The health benefits of Cereus nyctago include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, analgesic, and antispasmodic effects.
